class.name: ResonanceStaticGeometry
class.brief_description: Static acoustic geometry for walls, floors, and other non-moving objects.
class.description: Subclass of [ResonanceGeometry] with [member dynamic] fixed to false. Included in the baked static scene export (Project -> Tools -> Nexus Resonance -> Export Active Scene). At runtime, geometry comes from [ResonanceStaticScene] when a valid static scene asset is loaded; individual static geometry nodes do not register themselves in that case. Use for walls, floors, ceilings, and other objects that never move. For doors, platforms, and other animated objects, use [ResonanceDynamicGeometry] instead. Inspector note: [member dynamic] and [member mesh_asset] are hidden on this type. [member export_all_children] is available for subtree export.
